title: Repository identity event (v1 wire format)
description:
One repository a provider sync observed, as the Auth Control Plane receives it from the auth outbox. The provider sync (the worker) is the producer: it appends one event per synced repository that has a provider id, in the transaction that records the repository effect as committed, through the auth schema function append_repository_identity_event (migration 0056). The auth service is the consumer: it upserts auth.repository_identities, the copy of the provider ids (D6651; ClickHouse repos stays the source).

STATE TRANSFER. The event carries the full current state of one repository (provider, provider id, live path, observed_at), so an add and a rename are the same event kind. Removal and transfer out of an organization are not events of this surface.

THE IDEMPOTENCY KEY IS (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, revision), and `revision` is PER AGGREGATE (the aggregate is one repository of one organization), never global. The `idempotency_key` must equal aggregate_type + ":" + aggregate_id + ":" + payload.revision, and `aggregate_id` must equal payload.organization_id + "/" + change.provider + "/" + change.provider_repo_id; the clients enforce both. Consumer rule: an event whose revision is at or below the revision the stored row was written from is decided and changes nothing; a larger revision replaces the stored state (no gap rule: each event carries the whole state). The consumer also keeps the newer observed_at: an event observed before the stored row is not applied.

`revision` is an integer token in 1..2^53-1; a decimal- or exponent-form token is refused by the clients on the raw token.

aggregate_id.description: "<organization uuid>/<provider>/<provider id>": one repository of one organization.

idempotency_key.description: Must equal aggregate_type:aggregate_id:payload.revision; the schema pins the shape and the clients enforce the equality (reject_by_client).

created_at.description: When the event committed (the database clock). RFC 3339, every component bounded as in error.v1.

organization_id.description: The organization the repository belongs to: the lowercase uuid of auth.organizations.

provider.description: The provider name (github, gitlab), the 0055 shape of repository_identities.provider.

provider_repo_id.description: The provider's stable numeric repository id, as text.

path.description: The live path as a canonical repository key (lowercase), the 0055 shape of repository_identities.current_path.

observed_at.description: When the sync fetched the repository. RFC 3339, every component bounded as in error.v1.
